entries.title: Membership Rates from November 1, 2026 (Tier A / Tier B / Tier C / Loyalty) — walkaway
entries.attachmentTitle: YMCA of Southern Arizona walkaway (Nov 2026 rates)
entries.content:
CURRENT membership rates (from November 1, 2026), the same at every branch. These replace the rates on the old flyers (valid through Oct 31, 2026).

Monthly facility membership rates (Tier A / Tier B / Tier C / Loyalty):
- Adult (24+): $50 / $45 / $40 / Loyalty $40
- Single Adult Family: $70 / $65 / $60 / Loyalty $60
- Family: $90 / $85 / $80 / Loyalty $80
- Young Adult (18–23): $29 (no Tier B or C) / Loyalty $24
- Youth: $15 (no Tier B, C or Loyalty)

Loyalty Rate: Adult and Family members who stay one consecutive year qualify for the Loyalty Rate, saving up to $10 per month. The Loyalty column matches the standard Nov 1 rates in the "Membership Fee Changes (Oct 1 & Nov 1, 2026) and the Bank Draft Discount" SOP — see that SOP for the Bank Draft Discount (bank account/EFT) amounts.

Program Memberships (program registration only, NO facility access), charged annually: $35 individual / $70 family.

Family and Single Adult Family memberships include 1 or 2 adults plus dependents 23 years and younger in the same household. A 30-day WRITTEN cancellation notice is required for all membership types. Financial Assistance: apply online at tucsonymca.org/financial-assistance (QR code on the walkaway). Hours vary by location (tucsonymca.org/locations).

Each branch has its own walkaway (attached to its Branch Info answer); this one is the general YMCA of Southern Arizona version. Main phone: 520-623-9622.

Source: new branch walkaway (membership flyer), updated Nov 2026.

entries.update: Branch Info — Lighthouse City/YMCA (hours, phone, amenities, membership flyer)
entries.content:
Phone: 520-795-9725 · tucsonymca.org/lighthouse

Wellness Center hours: Monday–Thursday 6am–8pm, Friday 6am–6pm, Saturday 7am–4pm, Sunday 12pm–4pm.

Amenities:
- Pool: seasonal OUTDOOR pool with aquatics classes and open swim
- Group exercise: Strength, Pilates, SilverSneakers, Yoga, Cycling
- Cardio, strength and free-weight areas: treadmills, bikes, strength machines, dumbbells, squat rack, etc.
- Discounted youth programs: sports, Y Kids Nights, Family Nights, camps, Youth & Teen Leadership (offerings vary by location)
- Personal training

Membership rates are the same at every branch — see "Membership Rates from November 1, 2026". The attached walkaway has this branch's rates, hours and amenities; amenity (pool, class) hours: scan the QR code on the walkaway or see tucsonymca.org/lighthouse.
